info.name: Dynamics 365 Business Central API v2.0
info.description:
Modern RESTful API for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, the cloud evolution of Dynamics NAV. Provides a comprehensive set of endpoints for managing customers, vendors, items, sales orders, purchase orders, accounts, journals, and other business entities. Supports OData query parameters for filtering, sorting, and pagination.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Dynamics Support
 Email: bcsupport@microsoft.com
